description: Manual gate generator driving gate, latched, extended gate and trigger outputs at once from one button

params.text: Drives every output on the module; holding it down holds the gate outputs high, and each press flips the latched outputs over
Sets how long the extended gate outputs stay on after the button is released, up to 10 seconds

outputs.text: 10V while the button is held down and 0V otherwise
0V while the button is held down and 10V otherwise
10V while the button is held down and for the time set by LENGTH after it is released, 0V otherwise
0V while the button is held down and for the time set by LENGTH after it is released, 10V otherwise
A short trigger pulse at 10V each time the button is pressed
Alternates between 10V and 0V with each press of the button, starting at 0V
Alternates between 0V and 10V with each press of the button, starting at 10V
